name: Coc dam
summary: Cóc dầm is a cóc fruit snack, on the sweet side of Con Market’s indoor counters in Da Nang, beside chè, sinh tố, and me dầm.
howToEat: Order it on the sweet side of the indoor counters.
where: Con Market’s indoor counters, from morning until about 15:00.
